x:
Kallur Subbarao was one of the prominent nationalist leaders of Rayalaseema (Dattamandalas). He actively led the anti- liquor (anti-arrack) campaign and promoted the Swadeshi Movement, encouraging the use of indigenous goods and the boycott of foreign products. He also participated in various phases of the Indian freedom struggle and contributed significantly to political awakening in Rayalaseema.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
